fields.description: CI run history (2026-10-05..2026-11-02, 258 runs) averages ~228 runner-min/day. 43 of 46 PR merges re-ran the full Rust suite on master for a tree the PR run had already passed (push runs: ~65 min/day). The macOS Rust 1.94.0 leg (~18 min/day) repeats OS-independent MSRV compilation already covered by Linux verify. Native Runlimit PostgreSQL runs on two toolchains for every change although 24 of 35 master commits touched none of its inputs (~16 min/day).
fields.acceptance_criteria: 1) A push to master skips Rust test steps only when a same-repository pull_request/merge_group run of ci.yml recorded the exact tree after every test job passed, and the master Rust cache is an exact hit; any failure to prove that runs the full job. 2) macOS subprocess job runs once on the pinned toolchain; Rust 1.94.0 stays covered by Linux verify. 3) Native Runlimit PostgreSQL runs once on the pinned toolchain, only when its local dependency closure or global build inputs change; a failed plan runs it. 4) Planner has unit tests; docs/testing.md and evidence statements describe the new scope.
fields.title: Cut duplicate Rust CI work: verified master pushes, pinned-only macOS, scoped Runlimit PostgreSQL

data.text: PR #75 (branch ci/cut-duplicate-runs-f0jz, commit 944767d). Local verification: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_*.py' -> 178 tests OK (1 skipped); actionlint clean; bash scripts/check_file_budget.sh no findings. Planner run against live API as push of master 45b451b -> no marker, full run. Replay over 35 master commits since 2026-10-05 selects Runlimit PostgreSQL for 10. scripts/verify.sh not run: no Rust source changed; the PR CI run is the Rust verification. Hosted push-skip path unverified until merge.

Hosted PR run 41436121525 (PR #75, 944767d) passed: plan 21s (selected Runlimit PostgreSQL because ci.yml/ci_plan.py changed), Native Runlimit PostgreSQL (1.98.1), verify 1.94.0 + 1.98.1, Subprocess harness (macOS, 1.98.1), Record verified tree uploaded verified-tree-1c25633b0daf3f44936af69b16c333b9599b4f6b (workflow_run.repository_id == head_repository_id == 1361034155). Test-merge refs/pull/75/merge has parents 45b451b (master) + 944767d and the same tree as 944767d. Local planner in push mode against the live API accepted the marker and returned tree_verified=true with that run URL. Remaining: first hosted master push after merge (expected to skip test steps on exact cache hits).

data.reason: Merged in PR #75 (merge b5c078f, tree 1c25633b, verified by PR run 41436121525). First master push run 41445502064 succeeded: planner marked the tree verified; every test job (verify 1.94.0/1.98.1, macOS 1.98.1, Runlimit PostgreSQL 1.98.1) had an exact cache hit, ran the reuse step and skipped its test steps; Record verified tree skipped on push. Job spans: plan 20s, Runlimit 30s, macOS 37s, verify 70s/89s (~4 runner-min vs ~51 for a full push run). Follow-up: docs/status.md 'Rust CI scope selection' row still says hosted push reuse unverified until merged.

fields.description: Every package declares rust-version 1.94 (SQLx 0.9.0's floor) and CI runs the full verify job on both 1.94.0 and 1.98.1 (~18 runner-min per run, ~60/day). Over 360 runs the 1.94.0 job failed alone twice, one a real compile break (use super as catalog; on 2026-09-26). The owner chose to raise the minimum to the pinned toolchain before first publication and drop the second job.
fields.acceptance_criteria: 1) Every published-candidate and example package declares the pinned toolchain as rust-version; evidence snapshots stay unchanged. 2) CI verify runs once on the pinned toolchain (weekly stable unchanged); the at-rest portability gate uses the same toolchain. 3) AGENTS.md, README and docs state the single-toolchain policy and what a pin bump requires. 4) Complete scripts/verify.sh passes on the pinned toolchain with any newly enabled MSRV-gated lints fixed. 5) The stale 'hosted push reuse unverified' status row from batter-f0jz is updated.
fields.title: Raise the workspace MSRV to the pinned Rust 1.98.1 and test one toolchain

data.text: Implemented on branch ci/msrv-pinned-wis2 (uncommitted, awaiting owner OK to open a PR). rust-version 1.94 -> 1.98.1 in 21 package manifests and 4 consumer-check templates (docs/evidence snapshot unchanged); ci.yml verify matrix ['1.98.1'] (weekly stable unchanged); at-rest portability workflow + script on 1.98.1; AGENTS/README/crate READMEs/guides/status/testing/references/ADR-006 amendment/three changelogs updated; batter-f0jz status row now cites run 41445502064. Rust 1.98.1 chosen over 1.98 because its only fix is a 1.98.0 vtable miscompilation (rust-lang/rust#161441). Local verification on pinned 1.98.1 (macOS arm64): all four Clippy configurations pass with no newly enabled MSRV lints; bash scripts/verify.sh exit 0 in 13 min; scripts/check-batter-at-rest-portability.sh exit 0 (package, unpacked artifact and separate consumer); python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts: 178 OK (1 skipped); actionlint clean. Hosted CI not yet run.
Committed 3d0da3e on ci/msrv-pinned-wis2 and opened PR #76 at the owner's request. Hosted CI pending.
